blocks.text: FlatList receives data and a function for each row. It can avoid keeping every distant row rendered at once.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `FlatList` uses `data`, `renderItem` and stable item keys to display a potentially large native list.

blocks.text: The app shows one row per book with a stable id for each.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use stable unique keys. Reusing the same key for two rows can mix up item state.
